paper.title: Demystifying Online Clustering of Bandits: Enhanced Exploration Under Stochastic and Smoothed Adversarial Contexts

settings.name_in_paper: Stochastic context setting, cluster gap gamma known
unmapped: Online clustering of bandits: u users each with parameter theta_i; users partitioned into m unknown clusters sharing parameters; user i_t drawn uniformly at random each round
Each round K arm feature vectors drawn i.i.d. from a fixed distribution X with ||X|| <= L and lambda_min(E[XX^T]) = lambda_x > 0
The learner knows the cluster gap gamma
settings.definition_quote:
At each round \(t=1,2, \dots, T\), the learner receives a user index
\(i_t \in [u]\) and a finite set of arms \(\mathcal{A}_t \subseteq \mathcal{A}\) where \(|\mathcal{A}_t| = K\).
Each arm \(a \in \mathcal{A}\) is associated with a feature vector \(\vec{x}_a \in \RR^d\), and we denote \(\mathcal{D}_{t} = \set{\vec{x}_a}_{a \in \mathcal{A}_t} \subseteq \RR^d\).
\(\mathcal{D}_t\) is also called \emph{context}.
When we need to emphasize the index of arms, we also denote \(\mathcal{A}_t = \set{a_{t,i}}_{i=1}^K\) and \(\mathcal{D}_t=\set{\vec{x}_{t,i}}_{i=1}^K\).

settings.name_in_paper: Stochastic context setting, cluster gap gamma unknown
unmapped: Online clustering of bandits: u users each with parameter theta_i; users partitioned into m unknown clusters sharing parameters; user i_t drawn uniformly at random each round
Clusters well separated: ||theta^i - theta^j|| >= gamma > 0 with gamma unknown
Each round K arm feature vectors drawn i.i.d. from a fixed distribution X with ||X|| <= L and lambda_min(E[XX^T]) = lambda_x > 0
settings.definition_quote: In this subsection, we present a phase-based algorithm \PhaseUniCLUB (\Cref{algo:clucb-unknown-gamma}) to handle the scenario where the parameter \(\gamma\) is unknown.

unmapped: Online clustering of bandits: u users, m unknown clusters, user i_t drawn uniformly each round
Contexts: adversary picks mu_a with ||mu_a||<=1, then adds truncated Gaussian noise N(0, sigma^2 I) truncated to [-R,R] per coordinate
The learner knows the perturbation level sigma, truncation R (through lambda_x_tilde and 1+sqrt(d)R in the edge deletion threshold)
settings.definition_quote: At each time step t, the feature vector x_a in D_t for each arm a in A_t is drawn by a ``smoothed'' adversary, meaning that the adversary first chooses an arbitrary vector mu_a in R^d with ||mu_a||<=1, then samples a noise vector eps_a ... from a truncated multivariate Gaussian distribution where each dimension is truncated within [-R, R] ... And the feature vector x_a = mu_a + eps_a.

symbols.gamma_c: minimum gap between cluster preference vectors
symbols.lambda_x: minimum eigenvalue of E[XX^T] for the context distribution

conditions: contexts i.i.d. from X with ||X||<=L, lambda_min(E[XX^T])=lambda_x>0 (Assumption 3)
tuning: beta = sqrt(d log(1+TL^2/(d lambda)) + 2 log(1/delta)) + sqrt(lambda)
T_0 = 16u log(u/delta) + 4u max{8L^2/lambda_x log(ud/delta), 512d/(gamma^2 lambda_x) log(u/delta)}

source.label: thm:regret-uniclub
source.quote: Under the stochastic context setting (Assumptions 1, 2, 3) and assuming the cluster gap \(\gamma\) is known, the expected regret of the \UniCLUB (\Cref{algo:clucb}) satisfies: \E[R(T)] = O(\frac{ud}{\gamma^2\lambda_x}\log(T) + d\sqrt{mT}\log(T)).

results.notes: Regret defined via expected rewards x^T theta, so pseudo-regret against per-round best arm. Proof gives explicit constants including max with 8L^2/lambda_x log(udT) term.

symbols.gamma_c: minimum gap between cluster preference vectors

source.label: thm:regret-unisclub
source.quote: Under the stochastic context setting (Assumptions 1, 2, 3) and assuming the cluster gap \(\gamma\) is known, the expected regret of the \UniSCLUB (\Cref{algo:sclucb}) satisfies: \E[R(T)] = O(\frac{ud}{\gamma^2\lambda_x}\log(T) + d\sqrt{mT}\log(T)).

symbols.gamma_c: minimum gap between cluster preference vectors (unknown)

source.label: thm:regret-gamma-unknown
source.quote: Under the stochastic context setting (Assumptions 1, 2, 3), the expected regret of algorithm \PhaseUniCLUB (\Cref{algo:clucb-unknown-gamma}) satisfies: \E[R(T)] = O(\frac{ud}{\gamma^5\lambda_x^2}\log(T) + (\frac{ud}{\lambda_x} \log(T))^{\frac{2}{3}} T^{\frac{1}{3}} + d\sqrt{mT}\log(T)).

results.notes: Proof gives general-alpha bound O(ud/(gamma^{2alpha+1} lambda_x^2) log T + T^{1/(alpha+1)}(ud log T/lambda_x)^{alpha/(alpha+1)} + d sqrt(mT) log T); theorem states alpha=2.

symbols.gamma_c: minimum gap between cluster preference vectors
symbols.sigma_pert: standard deviation of the Gaussian context perturbation

conditions: Assumptions 1, 2, 4 (smoothed adversarial contexts with truncated Gaussian perturbation)
tuning: lambda_x replaced by lambda_x_tilde and L by 1+sqrt(d)R in the edge-deletion threshold

source.label: thm:regret-smoothed-adversary
source.quote: Under the smoothed adversarial context setting (Assumptions 1, 2, 4), the expected regrets of \SACLUB and \SASCLUB both satisfy: \E[R(T)] = O(\frac{ud}{\gamma^2\widetilde{\lambda}_x} \log(T) + d\sqrt{mT}\log(T)), where \widetilde{\lambda}_x = c_1 \frac{\sigma^2}{\log K} for some constant c_1.

results.notes: Proof only sketched ('almost the same techniques'). Environment mapped to adversarial_smoothed for contexts; reward noise is stochastic.

symbols.gamma_c: minimum gap between cluster preference vectors
symbols.sigma_pert: standard deviation of the Gaussian context perturbation

conditions: Assumptions 1, 2, 4 (smoothed adversarial contexts with truncated Gaussian perturbation)
tuning: lambda_x replaced by lambda_x_tilde and L by 1+sqrt(d)R in thresholds

source.label: thm:regret-smoothed-adversary
source.quote: Under the smoothed adversarial context setting (Assumptions 1, 2, 4), the expected regrets of \SACLUB and \SASCLUB both satisfy: \E[R(T)] = O(\frac{ud}{\gamma^2\widetilde{\lambda}_x} \log(T) + d\sqrt{mT}\log(T)).

results.notes: Same theorem as r4, for the set-based SASCLUB; proof details skipped in paper.
